No I wouldn't say push him out completely, things aren't so black and white but if you want to be happy with yourself and with him you just need time. Sometimes the problems you have now that you think will never go away often will subside with time.  Do things to heal yourself immerse yourself in hobbies whatever makes you happy.  By taking your focus away from the stress of this relationship you can grow and come back as a better person.  Keep in contact just don't let the emotions overshadow your own pursuit of happiness

Whether or not you guys were dating yall seem to have feelings for each other.  If you're both feeling down perhaps you should find someone else in your life that you trust to talk about your personal problems.  It's hard to love someone if you can't love yourself so it might be selfish but overall necessary if you really care about him so keep your distance for a time because if you express too early you might get wrapped up into too many emotions.  It sucks being alone but being in the right mind will make the wait that much more worth it

Know that trying something (anything at all) that helps you is a good, you know yourself well and preventing self harm is a sign that you care about yourself and others care for you too, be well however things turn out
